description.en: A massive, single-vendor e-commerce platform featuring multiple product lines, coupled with a robust CRM, inventory tracking, accounting invoices, and extensive reporting.

problem.en: The client (Kenz) needed more than a basic storefront. They required a unified solution to manage diverse product catalogs, track complex inventory, and handle accounting natively without third-party subscriptions.

solution.en: Built a comprehensive e-commerce ecosystem. The customer-facing store is highly optimized for sales, while the backend serves as a full-fledged ERP and CRM. It tracks every item from warehouse to delivery and generates detailed accounting invoices.

outcome.en: Kenz operates entirely on a single, self-sufficient platform. Operational costs dropped by avoiding fragmented SaaS fees, and inventory accuracy reached 100%.

description.en: An innovative online web simulator mimicking a desktop application environment using advanced React, Three.js, and WebGL rendering.

problem.en: There was a need to demonstrate native desktop-like behavior entirely within a modern web browser, challenging standard web UX boundaries.

solution.en: Leveraged React 19, Three.js, and React Three Fiber to build a dynamic, fluid simulator. Integrated Framer Motion for smooth window/app transitions mirroring OS interactions.

outcome.en: Delivered a visually stunning and highly interactive web simulator that effectively bridges the gap between web applications and native desktop software experiences.

description.en: The first iteration of my personal portfolio, designed as a single-page cinematic 3D experience to showcase projects interactively.

problem.en: Wanted to break away from traditional grids and list-based portfolios by creating an unforgettable first impression.

solution.en: Built a single-page immersive 3D experience where projects are explored cinematically rather than scrolled linearly.

outcome.en: Served as a powerful creative milestone. It successfully demonstrated high-level frontend capabilities before pivoting to the current, more comprehensive digital services platform.

description.en: A highly customized corporate website for a digital marketing agency, built on a custom Astra child theme to ensure blazing-fast performance and brand alignment.

problem.en: The marketing agency required a lightweight, ultra-fast website that could easily manage content while retaining a highly custom, branded design without the bloat of heavy builders.

solution.en: Developed a custom Astra child theme. Wrote tailored PHP and CSS to bypass unnecessary scripts, delivering a lean WordPress experience.

outcome.en: The site achieved exceptional Core Web Vitals, perfectly reflecting the agency's premium status and helping them attract high-ticket clients via organic SEO.
